2609.26826.title: What Makes a Terminal-Bench Task Hard? Separating Genuine Hardness from Fake-Hardness on an Adjudicated Agentic Corpus
2609.26826.paper_summary: Frontier benchmarks need tasks that current models cannot solve. But a task that no model solves is not automatically a hard task. The same zero pass rate can come from a real capability gap, but it can also come from missing context, a broken reference solution, infrastructure failure, or a verifier that can be bypassed. In this paper, we study this issue using a frozen Terminal-Bench 3 / Frontier-Bench 0.1 production record with 1,081 pull requests, 639 scored tasks, 28,801 trials, and $105,933 in logged agent spend. We ask what an all-fail task actually certifies. For the 125 tasks with no honest pass, we combine task artifacts, reference-solution runs, empty-solution controls, adversarial trials, trajectories, telemetry, and review records, and apply an ordered validity screen. Only 78 of the 125 tasks survive as certified-unsolved candidates. The remaining tasks include 14 with broken oracles, 8 dominated by infrastructure failures, 4 that are only passable through verifier bypasses, and 21 whose solvability is not certified by the available evidence. Thus, lack of saturation and genuine difficulty are not the same thing. The certified-unsolved label is also narrow: it means that the authored route passed, infrastructure did not dominate, no strict bypass was observed, and all evaluated agents failed. It does not prove intrinsic hardness, verifier completeness, or failure at the intended capability. We further analyze rejected submissions and passing tasks to show that pass rate alone cannot explain why a task is difficult. Overall, our results suggest that frontier benchmarks should report the evidence behind their all-fail tasks before using them as capability claims.
2609.26826.paper_summary_zh: 前沿基準需要當前模型無法解決的任務。但一個沒有模型解決的任務並不自動意味著這是一個困難的任務。相同的零通過率可能來自真正的能力差距，但也可能來自缺乏上下文、破損的參考解決方案、基礎設施故障，或可以被繞過的驗證器。在本文中，我們使用一個凍結的 Terminal-Bench 3 / Frontier-Bench 0.1 生產記錄進行研究，該記錄包含 1,081 個拉取請求、639 個得分任務、28,801 次試驗，和 $105,933 的記錄代理支出。我們詢問一個全失敗任務實際上認證了什麼。對於 125 個沒有誠實通過的任務，我們結合任務文檔、參考解決方案執行、空解決方案控制、對抗性試驗、軌跡、遙測和審查記錄，並應用有序有效性篩選。只有 125 個任務中的 78 個作為認證未解決候選者存活下來。剩餘的任務包括 14 個具有破損預言機、8 個被基礎設施故障主導、4 個僅能通過驗證器繞過而通過的，以及 21 個其可解性未被現有證據認證的。因此，缺乏飽和度和真正的困難並不是同一回事。認證未解決標籤也很狹窄：這意味著所創建的路徑通過，基礎設施沒有主導，沒有觀察到嚴格的繞過，並且所有評估的代理均失敗。這並不能證明內在的困難性、驗證器的完整性，或在預期能力上的失敗。我們進一步分析被拒絕的提交和通過的任務，以顯示通過率本身無法解釋為什麼一個任務是困難的。總體而言，我們的結果表明，前沿基準應在將其全失敗任務用作能力聲明之前報告其背後的證據。
